title: Explosive Russian drone boat destroyed near European offshore gas site
summary: This week, Romania accused Russia of sending a drone boat loaded with explosives to a vital European natural gas platform in the Black Sea. Both Russian and Ukrainian drones have also sometimes strayed into the airspace of European countries such as Romania.
